horasDetalle.auto: The light changes on its own with your phone’s clock

configuracion.animacionesExplicacion: Animations celebrate what you learn and gently accompany your prayer. If they distract you or make you dizzy, choose Reduced.

animacionesDetalle.sistema: Follows your phone’s Reduce Motion setting

configuracion.inclinacion: Move the light when you tilt your phone
configuracion.inclinacionDetalle: The light in the stained glass shifts a little as you tilt your phone. No permissions needed.
configuracion.inclinacionReducidas: Not available while animations are reduced.
configuracion.idiomaPaisExplicacion: They come from your phone; you can change them anytime. Your country sets the helplines you see and the feasts your country celebrates on a different day.

recordatorios.horaExplicacion: Reminders you turn on for each novena start at this time. You can also change it there.
recordatorios.ninguno: You have no active reminders. You can turn them on in each novena.
recordatorios.noDisponibles: Reminders need the app installed on your phone. They aren’t available in this test version.

privacidad.sinCuenta: You don’t need an account or to sign in.
privacidad.sinAnuncios: There are no ads and no analytics.
privacidad.sinUbicacion: We don’t use your location: your country comes from your phone’s region.
privacidad.enTuTelefono: What you pray, feel or learn is kept only on this phone. Nothing leaves it.
privacidad.borrarPista: Asks you to confirm before deleting

borrado.intro: This will be deleted from this phone:
borrado.velas: The candles you lit in your novenas
borrado.aprender: Your traits and medals in Learn
borrado.preferencias: Your preferences: palette, language, country and text size
borrado.advertencia: This can’t be undone. The app will start again from the welcome screen.
borrado.error: We couldn’t finish deleting your data. Please try again.

apoyo.gratis: {{app}} is free and ad-free, and it will stay that way.
apoyo.costos: Publishing it has costs: Google Play charges USD 25 once and Apple charges USD 99 a year.
apoyo.nadaSeDesbloquea: If you’d like, you can contribute to cover them. Contributing doesn’t unlock anything: the app is the same for everyone.
apoyo.pronto: Soon you’ll be able to contribute from the store.
apoyo.gracias: Thank you for supporting the app.
apoyo.error: The contribution couldn’t be completed. Please try again later.
apoyo.patrocinioPista: Opens their website in the browser

acercaDe.bibliaDetalle: Reina-Valera 1909 in Spanish and the King James Version in English, both in the public domain.

novenas.guia: Nine days of prayer ending on the saint's feast. We tell you when to start.
novenas.sinNovenas: There are no novenas loaded yet.
novenas.tocaUnaVela: Tap a candle to see that day's prayer.
novenas.fiestaTexto: The nine days of prayer lead to today's feast.
novenas.oracionMarcador: Day {{n}} of the novena to {{nombre}}. The prayer and intention for this day will go here.
novenas.oracionProximamente: Prayer of the day coming soon
novenas.apagarPista: Puts out the candle for day {{n}}
novenas.diaFuturo: You can mark this day on {{fecha}}.
novenas.avisamePista: Asks permission to send you a reminder on each remaining day of the novena
novenas.sinPermiso: To remind you, the app needs permission to show notifications. If you like, you can allow it in your phone's settings.
novenas.sinDiasPorAvisar: At that time there are no days of this novena left to remind you about.
novenas.errorAvisos: We couldn't set the reminders. Please try again.
novenas.anuncioAvisos: We'll remind you every day at {{hora}}

aviso.cuerpo: Whenever you're ready, today's prayer is here.

novenas.noEncontradaDetalle: Go back to the list and pick another.

bienvenida.texto: Confirm your language and country. Your country lets us show you real help where you live, should you ever need it. We don’t use your location, and nothing leaves your phone.
bienvenida.confirmarPista: Saves the language and country and opens the app

pais.explicacion: We only use it to show you helplines in your country. It stays on your phone.
pais.otro: Another country, or I’d rather not say
pais.otroDetalle: We’ll show you {{sitio}}, a worldwide directory of helplines, and a reminder to call the local emergency number wherever you are.

hoy.sinSanto: We don’t have today’s saint loaded yet
hoy.privacidad: No account. What you mark stays on your phone.

santo.sinHistoria: We don’t have this story loaded yet.
santo.noEncontradoDetalle: Their story may not be in the app yet.

emociones.guia: Pick one. You will get a Bible verse, a prayer and a saint who went through the same.
emociones.mosaicoPista: Opens a verse, a prayer and a companion saint
emociones.otraOracionPista: Shows another verse, prayer and saint for this feeling
emociones.otraAnuncio: For today, {{n}} of {{total}}. {{referencia}}. Walking with you: {{santo}}.
emociones.sinEntrada: A verse, a prayer and a saint for this feeling will be here soon.
emociones.noEncontrada: We could not find this feeling.
emociones.noEncontradaDetalle: Go back to the list and pick another one.

ayuda.titulo: You do not have to carry this alone.
ayuda.texto: If you feel very low or think about hurting yourself, talk to someone today. Asking for help is also an act of faith.
ayuda.llamarPista: Opens the dialer with the number filled in. You decide whether to call.
ayuda.marcarAMano: Dial it in your phone app.
ayuda.sinMarcador: We could not open the dialer. Dial the number on your phone.
ayuda.sinDatosPais: We do not have verified helplines for {{pais}} yet.
ayuda.sinDatos: We do not have verified helplines for your country yet.
ayuda.abrirRespaldoPista: Opens the website in your browser
ayuda.otroPaisPista: Choose your country to see its helplines

aprender.guia: Read their story, discover their traits and earn their medal.
aprender.sinLecturas: Readings about saints are coming soon.
aprender.responderQuizPista: Opens the quiz for this reading
aprender.necesitas: You need {{pass}} of {{total}} for the medal.
aprender.noEncontradaDetalle: Go back to Learn and choose another one.
aprender.casi: Almost. Review the reading and come back whenever you like.

aprender.anuncioColeccion: You completed the {{nombre}} collection and earned its medal.
aprender.sinGanar: You haven't earned this medal yet. Read the story and take the quiz.
